trivialityOptOuts.reason: invisibleMeshes counts solid meshes the renderer still draws at zero opacity, which is a state nothing in this game should ever be in except a parked effect pool. It is not trivially zero: the healthy scene sits at 177, the pooled muzzle flashes, impact bursts and smoke that wait at opacity 0 until they are spawned. The ceiling is 300 so a new pool does not trip it, and the failure it exists for lands at 814 -- one prewarm(ctx.scene) call, which cloned every material in the town to opacity 0 and left the player looking at nothing but sky. Every other assertion passed on that build: the frame was nonblank, decals still placed, pathfinding still solved, diagnostics were clean, triangles went UP from 702,618 to 1,101,003 because transparency unbatches, and a dark-pixel-ratio check on the weapon region read 0.25 against 0.37 for the real frame. A counter of what cannot be seen was the only thing that separated them.
